title: Native launch still and adjacent splash
lede: The inactive snapshot no longer uses a privacy lock. Cold launch, session restore, sign-in, and password setup now share the Motion W lockup on the crimson splash scene.

sections.heading: After-only fixture evidence
sections.note: iPhone 16 Pro (27.0) UDID E055DEBC-12B1-4E0F-BE11-1CFFF4A454DE, WisconsinPerformance launch-view / login / password-setup, dark splash appearance. No matched before pair: the previous privacy lock lived only in the inactive app-switcher snapshot, which the fixture harness cannot freeze without changing scene phase during capture.

shots.title: Launch still
shots.cap: Centered Motion W and Wisconsin Creative wordmark on the crimson splash. Session-checking copy appears only after restore takes long enough. No lock icon.

shots.title: Sign-in
shots.cap: The live Gotham lockup sits on the same scene as the still. The light card is email-first Continue and passkey, unchanged in contract.

shots.title: Set password
shots.cap: Forced-password setup now uses the scene lockup and the same light card chrome as sign-in, instead of a small W inside an opaque white card.

changes.was: A systemBackground cover with lock.shield.fill and Wisconsin Creative in secondary label color.
changes.now: The same LaunchBackground plus LaunchLockup still as the system launch frame. Identity, not a privacy lock.

changes.was: LaunchBackground color only, so returning users saw a blank maroon flash.
changes.now: Centered transparent LaunchLockup on LaunchBackground for both the main app and WisconsinKiosk.

changes.was: Login used a 72pt mark. Password setup put a 52pt W and title inside an opaque card.
changes.now: Both keep the lockup on the splash scene. The card chrome is shared. The W is 80pt with tight Gotham tracking.

verification: vitest ios-launch-experience, ios-login-presentation, ios-forced-password, password-manager-integration, and ios-kiosk-windowing-cleanup passed (31 tests).
ios-system-hardening snapshot contract passed in isolation. Three other hardening tests in that file fail on unrelated pre-existing session-boundary assertions.

xcodebuild WisconsinKiosk generic iOS Simulator Debug BUILD SUCCEEDED.

notes: The launch-still capture includes Checking your session because the fixture waited through the delayed progress reveal. The system UILaunchScreen itself has no spinner.
Kiosk resume uses the same LaunchLockup raster; managed-iPad visual proof remains open.
